批量背景删除工作流程：

包含许多节点以及使用多种模型，所有这些模型都是为了从单个图像中删除背景而设置的。以盎司为单位进行测试，看看哪种最适合您的图像。

可能需要一些设置，例如安装自定义节点以及获取 API 密钥。

o.en:
Batch Background Remove Workflow:

Contains many nodes as well as using a big variety of models that all is set up to remove the background from a single image. Test all at ounce and see which works best for your image.

Some setup could be required like installing custom node as well as getting API key.
